caption: The drawing features three views of a metal box-like object with a green dome-shaped knob on top and a flat red roof. The primary view, on the left, shows the front and side of the object. The front panel is decorated with lattice-like patterns, blue accents, and the words “HALL’S EXCELSIOR BANK” in raised letters. There are also two small blue shapes at the upper corners and a central arched doorway with small dots and blue highlights, as well as a green rectangular slot beneath the door. The side panel has a grid of crisscrossed lines forming diamond shapes. The base of the object is painted red. The view at the bottom right shows the back of the object, which has multiple evenly spaced circular holes and a continuation of the red base and roof. The top right view shows a green dome-like shape at one end and an open compartment containing a small, human-like figure lying down, dressed in a red top, white sleeve, and black pants or skirt, with an orange bed or platform below the figure. The background is plain and off-white. The artist’s name "W. O. Fletcher" is written in small letters at the bottom right corner.
title: Wall's Excelsior Bank (mechanical)
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
